text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text: While out shopping, I spotted Biko Pegasus patrolling the shopping district... with Shinko Windy sneaking around right behind her.

text_block_list.name: Shinko Windy
text_block_list.text:
Hm-hmmm!? You curious!?
About Windy-chan's master plan! Well, if you insist!

text_block_list.name: Shinko Windy
text_block_list.text:
Namely... "Operation: Eradicate Justice"!
I'm gonna steal all the credit from Biko's patrols!

text_block_list.name: Shinko Windy
text_block_list.text: That guy's seriously so cheeky! Whenever I invite him to play tag, he turns me down saying he's on patrol!

text_block_list.name: Shinko Windy
text_block_list.text:
And... even if I wait for her to finish and invite her out,
she just heads straight back to the dorms...

text_block_list.name: Shinko Windy
text_block_list.text: That is why I have resolved! I will resolve every trouble beforehand, so that her sense of purpose—

text_block_list.name: Biko Pegasus
text_block_list.text:
See ya, Grandma!
Be careful not to trip next time, alright?!

text_block_list.name: Shinko Windy
text_block_list.text:
Hey, Biko! Did you just go and help someone?!
How dare you steal Windy-chan's credit, grrrr!

text_block_list.name: Biko Pegasus
text_block_list.text:
Credit? Wait, Senpai, did you come to help out?!
That saves my skin! There are some troubles
I just can't handle on my own!

text_block_list.name: Shinko Windy
text_block_list.text:
WRONNNG! I'm not helping out at all!
Why would Windy-chan do something that tiring?!
choice_data_list: Hurry and be honest with yourself!
You should help relieve some of their fatigue.

text_block_list.name: Shinko Windy
text_block_list.text: Whaaat?! Wh-Wh-What are you talking about?!

text_block_list.name: Biko Pegasus
text_block_list.text:
Honest? Is there something else you wanted to say?
I'm all ears!
choice_data_list: Come on, pluck up your courage.

text_block_list.name: Shinko Windy
text_block_list.text:
Ngh... Urgh... SHUUUUT UUUUUP!
I hate you guys!

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
Screaming those words with a beet-red face,
Shinko Windy sprinted away
into the distance...

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text: I suggested to Shinko Windy that perhaps they turned down tag simply because they were exhausted from patrol duty.

text_block_list.name: Shinko Windy
text_block_list.text: ...! Does that mean if we reduce our fatigue, we can play tag?!

text_block_list.name: Shinko Windy
text_block_list.text:
I-It can't be helped... I shall lend you a hand!
Biko, you had best be grateful!

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
And so, the two patrolled hand in hand...
and peace across the shopping district was preserved.
